notes.title: Battle Bands Update 1.2
notes.content:
[i]You're listening to Riff Radio, brought to you by Rod's Lightning Rods "Shockingly good value!", located in downtown Riff City right next to Shady Steve's! [/i]

[h3]Update 1.2 has a few new things for you all, including a new highly requested feature tied to Milestones and Prestige Levels called Endorsements, a "new" card for the Keyboardist, 4 new moments and a bunch of card changes.[/h3]

[h2]New Feature: Endorsements[/h2]

Endorsements are a way for you to alter your starting deck(s) at the beginning of each Tour.
[list]
[*] Complete Milestones to unlock Endorsement slots at Prestige Levels 3, 6, and 10.
[*] Each Instrument has 3 unique Endorsements to unlock.
[*] Endorsements are unlocked at every Prestige level starting from Level 3 and stopping at Level 10.
[*] Your band can have a total of 3 [i]active[/i] Endorsements once all 3 slots are unlocked.
[/list]
[b]You can activate the Endorsements you want from the "Prestige" tab in the Compendium.[/b]

Check them out and let us know if there are any Endorsements you would want to see in a future update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/e8422cbc4263e86edcba932cab2a92f3f1b1def1.png[/img]

[h2]New Moments[/h2]

There are 4 new moments to find as well. Some of which give you new ways to use the "Rubber Duck" gear.
[list]
[*] New Fishing Spot
[*] A Council of Birds
[*] The Shadowy Hitchhiker
[*] Riff City Duck Races
[/list]

[h2]Card Balance & Changes[/h2]

[i]Grand Hook card added to Keyboardist deck.[/i]

Previously, we had two achievements tied to beating or losing to us developers and players ranked Legend in Royale Mode. This has been updated so players can be additionally granted this achievement through winning or losing to an Iconic Band (Gold plated name) in Royale Mode. 

Removed upgrade Warm, replaced with Furious (Adds 1 Fingers Furious Keys to Graveyard on Play)

Aggressive Upgrade now gives only 1 Broken Things to random opponents hand instead of 2.

[list]
[*] Grand Hook now does -3 to the opposing band’s protection on Complete.
[*] Soothing Melody now gives +2 protection While in Play.
[*] Repeat The Beat now has Retain by default.
[*] Fun Hook now gives +1 Protection on Complete.
[*] Finger Furious Keys now gives +1 hype to all other “Finger Furious Keys” in current Song Section.
[*] Echo Of The Shred! now gives +1 hype for every other “Echo Of The Shred!” in current Song Section.
[*] Dramatic Keys replaced Pensive upgrade with Mean
[*] Prestigious Jam added upgrade “Epic”.
[*] Comedic Lick -1 base hype and now removes 1 hype from opposing band per 1 performance in your current Song Section on play.
[*] Mirroring Melody gained +1 protection and the Safe upgrade was replaced with Quickly. 
[*] Rockin’ To The Beat gained Well Timed upgrade.
[*] Soothing Melody gained +1 protection while in play.
[*] Killer Jam gained Distracting upgrade.
[*] Head Shake -1 base hype and replaced Jacked Up with With Feeling upgrade.
[*] Guitarist’s Catchy Chorus had the Defensive upgrade replaced with Engaging.
[*] Enticing Riff had the With Feeling upgrade replaced with Engaging.
[*] Mock Their Buddies now has 1 less pip required to upgrade the card. Upgrade With Feeling replaced with Wicked, and Mean replaced with Ruthless.
[*] Yielding Howl now has 2 less pips required to upgrade the card.
[*] Well Practiced Chorus now has +1 Protection on Complete.
[*] Blistering Finale now has +1 hype.
[*] Interpretive Interlude now has +1 hype.
[*] Tell The Crowd They Are The Best now has 5 base protection.
[*] Hoot is now Tier 3.
[*] Movement of Calm had it’s hype reduced by 1.
[*] Promises of Success had the Pleasant upgrade replaced with Maintain.
[*] Quick Dig now does -3 Hype to opposing band.
[*] Clever Dig now does -4 Hype to opposing band.
[*] Sick Dig now does -6 Hype to opposing band.
[*] Head Slam had the Mean upgrade replaced with Ruthless, and the Inspire upgrade replaced with Repeatable.
[*] Dance Section had the Quickly upgrade replaced with Distracting.
[*] Muse no longer gives self 1 Honest Sadness per turn.
[/list]

Thank you to our Discord community for all the thoughtful feedback, these changes are the direct result of your support. Special shoutout to Nar for the card-balance-brain-dump and compilation!

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Prestigious Jam typo fixed.
[*] Missing "Duck Moments" added.
[*] Tell the Crowd card play restriction fixed.
[*] Disconnected players will no longer show in reloaded Tours as bots with the same name.
[*] Experimental fix for Shadow Band sometimes creating Snare Hit(s) in a player deck.
[/list]

[i]And that's it for Update 1.2! A big, big thanks to everyone giving us feedback! Be sure to check out the Discord if you have any feedback or are looking for someone to jam with. Thanks for listening![/i]

notes.title: Battle Bands: Full 1.0 Release!
notes.content:
Denizens of Riff City, after around 2 years of Early Access, Battle Bands 1.0 is here! 
It has been an incredible journey and we are so excited to share this version of the game with both new players and the absolute legends who have helped us along the way by providing crucial feedback during Early Access.

[b]Lets start off with the updated trailer:[/b]
[b][previewyoutube=RSVqS3zceow;full][/previewyoutube][/b]

[h2]Here's a taste of what we're dishing out for the 1.0 patch![/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40738613/7be0cced8336cbdd946535dfdc03cdaeae143365.png[/img]
[h3]The Shadow Band's Reign[/h3]
The Shadow Band is a mysterious and unique new reigning final boss in tour mode. Unlocked after you've won a Tour, the Shadow Band will take on the look, deck and gear of the band you most recently beat a Tour run with!
[h3]The Metal Moon Rises[/h3]
The moon over Riff City's got a strange new sheen, and it has bestowed us with a brand new Backstage Pass, new items in Joe's Variety Shop, and a hard rocking look to the streets of Riff City.
[h3]Grand Royales Get an Update[/h3]
Grand Royales will now happen every two hours, and they have their own unique Radio Interview moments, plus SUPER VENDORS with the widest assortments of gear Riff City has ever seen! They also will have 9 iconic bots hidden among the ranks, giving you more chances to beat them for unique rewards. Speaking of Iconic Bots, there's 9 new ones for players to track down in Royales Grand or otherwise, so go ready up for the next tourney!
[h3]Leaderboards Have Been Reset[/h3]
The Tour High Score Board and the Royale Rankings have both been reset, plus there's new License Titles to unlock for ranking in the top 100 for either board.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1322100/partnerevents/preview/3820802116155788179][b]CLICK HERE TO READ MORE ABOUT THE BIG UPDATE IN OUR PATCH NOTES![/b][/url]

[h2]A Moment to Reflect on the Early Access Journey[/h2]

Looking back, it's amazing to think of how different Battle Bands was and was shaping up to be before we entered Early Access. The road has been full of twists, turns and a few potholes, but the friends in our community we've picked up along the way have helped us keep our tour van on track to deliver what we truly believe is the [i]best[/i] version of Battle Bands.

[b]This is a shot of one of the earliest prototypes for Battle Bands[/b]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40738613/3d2c35b9356f33de25d7c8f85042d97879e4c411.png[/img]
[b]And this is what the game looks like now![/b]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40738613/5316873b3a364d0d04d829e05f3db2c2cf6161ec.png[/img]

[h3]Here's some of the many major updates we made during Early Access:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Completely Removed all micro transactions from the game
[*] Added a fully offline mode
[*] Added ability to save Tour runs
[*] Countless balance tweaks and bug fixes
[*] The ability to switch between automated bot bandmates and manually controlled bandmates
[*] A LOT of work on making both friendly and rival bots well oiled machines
[*] Added leaderboards 
[*] Added several new rival bands to face off against
[*] Added new arenas to rock out in
[*] Added a bunch of alternate Final Bosses and Reigns to increase replayability 
[*] Added the compendium and guidebook to better track your progress and keep players informed
[*] 3 full, free Backstage Passes with 50 levels of gameplay-driven unlocks each
[*] TONS of additional cosmetics to unlock and use to create a unique look for your band
[*] Added difficulty modifiers so players can play their way
[/list]
[b]And SO MUCH MORE! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1322100]Check out our looong list of updates and patches to see more![/url]
[/b]

[h2]The future of Battle Bands[/h2]
Early Access may be coming to an end, but now is the beginning of a new era of Battle Bands! Going forward we'll continue fixing bugs, tweaking balance, and improving quality of life features. We also hope to tackle things like controller support, additional languages and EVEN MORE rad content to jam to!

[h2]Wrapping up...[/h2]
We're not just being sappy when we say we wouldn't be where we're at without the love and support we've seen from our community. It's a tough thing to play to an empty room, so your showing up really means the world to us. If you haven't already, please consider helping the 1.0 launch really pop off by leaving us a review on Steam, telling your friends and favorite streamers about Battle Bands, and hitting us up in our Discord server to give us feedback.

[url=discord.gg/battlebands][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1322100/extras/BB_steamBody_discordHeader.png?t=1647433923[/img][/url]

Now go get some snacks for the road, and we'll see [i]you[/i] in the Riff City streets!

notes.title: Battle Bands: The Final Early Access Patch!
notes.content:
[i]Like a rainbow in the dark, you're listening to Riff Radio![/i]

The Final [b]Early Access[/b] Patch for Battle Bands includes the Shadow Band reign, a new Backstage Pass and a whole lot of metal!

[h2]Shadow Bands[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/f00fce06602b3afce1d4d8cfd24624558bb73fd1.png[/img]
Once players have pulled out a victory in Tour Mode, they'll be able to take on the Shadow Band- a group of four shadowy figures imitating the last band you won a Tour with! The Shadow Band reign combines reign-specific moments, cards, gear and upgrades from all of the other available reigns, opening up all sorts of crazy strategies. They'll use all your best moves against you, so you'll have to be clever to win and get your hands on a sweet new van!

[h2]Metal Moon Rising[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/20d2e2d15b832466a237546be5b2fab42a7b4e31.png[/img]
Also in this patch is a brand-new Metal themed Backstage Pass, brought along by a strangely shiny new Moon hanging over Riff City. Along with those 50 new levels of rewards to rock through, there's also a whole host of new cosmetic items to grab in Joe's Variety Shop! The Metal Moon has also provided a terrifying new login reward for us and all of Riff City is decked out in a new hard rocking aesthetic, so go check out their killer outfits! Just don't hit any of those big spikes sticking out of the ground with your van...

[h2]Grand Royales get more Grand![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/0a027f04e58d35fd973badf9dfe1128d2fad3357.png[/img]
Grand Royales will now happen every 2 hours and have their own unique opening Radio Interviews, as well as Super Vendors, which are uniquely large vendors with 16 gear options for you to spend your winnings on! They also have 9 iconic bots waiting to take you on. Speaking of iconic bots, there's also 9 new ones for you to track down and win unique cosmetics from in all Royales!

[h3]Bug Fixes, Balance changes and Quality of Life:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Leaderboards have been reset
[*] New titles for players that rank in the top 100 for both Tour and Royale leaderboards- Founding Genius and Founding Champion respectively
[*] More "Info" buttons added throughout game for easier Guidebook access
[*] Credits screen added to Guidebook
[*] For new players, "Manual" is now the default control mode for bots
[*] Guidebook typos fixed
[*] "Snackrificial Sharing" card description fixed
[*] Sound fx added to Joe's Variety navigation arrows
[/list]

[i]That's all for today's broadcast! This may be our last Early Access update, but tomorrow will mark the official 1.0 release of Battle Bands, so jump in our Discord and lets get this party going for real![/i]

[url=discord.gg/battlebands][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1322100/extras/BB_steamBody_discordHeader.png?t=1647433923[/img][/url]

notes.title: Joe's Variety Shop Changes
notes.content:
[h1]New Cosmetic Shop Layout![/h1]

[b]Joe's Variety[/b], also known as the cosmetic shop, is undergoing a minor remodel.

Our primary goal is to [i]eliminate[/i] the fear of missing out (FOMO) in the game, so we've chosen to redesign Joe's Variety to showcase all available cosmetics simultaneously.

Use the filters on the right to specify the type of cosmetic you'd like to browse for. Then, using the directional arrows, flip through and purchase a ton of cosmetics for your band. From a Pineapple Head to a Dead Fish keyboard, there are tons of outfits to unlock.

This change comes just in time for the [b]Metal Moon Rising event[/b] which adds over 45 new cosmetics to Joe's Variety, making for a grand total of over 150 outfits to collect!

We hope this update will empower players to create their ultimate band, without any FOMO!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/66f4b56425e0f4305b81637d5d04472ac6b544f2.png[/img]

We're also renaming in-game currency from [i]Credits[/i] to [b]Tokens[/b]!

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Gear Getter now has the Disruptive upgrade.
[*] Switching between Remove and Upgrade during the Tuning screen now displays correctly.
[*] Audio for all Opening Moments (Tour and Royale) fixed.
[*] "Man with a sign" Moment now has correct roll percentage.
[*] z-fighting fix on player dress mesh.
[*] in-match chat command display bug fixed.
[*] Tour Mode turn-timers are set to "Off" on default settings.
[/list]

[h3][b]All Tokens used to buy cosmetics are obtained exclusively through gameplay![/b][/h3]

[i]FOMO! FOMO! FOMO![/i]

notes.title: Battle Bands Early Access Patch 30
notes.content:
[i]You're listening to Riff Radio, and it's time to feed your head![/i]

Early Access Patch #30: The Information Amplification Update brings Match Summary and a Guidebook to help teach players all the ins and outs of Battle Bands, as well as Rockers' Licenses! The Information Amplification Update is also full of bug fixes and balance updates as we prepare for full release!

[h3]The Guidebook[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/fb3de187263f42789e46223ec9d663969862154d.png[/img]

The Guidebook comprehensively shows new and old players alike all the information needed to master Battle Bands. Become an expert in all the terms, icons and game mechanics you'll need to rock Riff City to its core!

[h3]Match Summary[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/08b0b80f650eeed95f7fa5f340d87b4698d7509b.png[/img]

Another other big feature of this patch is the Match Summary screen, which will now pop up after every match you play! The Match Summary screen lets players learn more about their challenger and where their own weaknesses may be by breaking down key strategies of both bands on the first page, followed by a more granular break down of raw stats on the second page. Remember, the pen is mightier than the guitar (or something like that)! You can also view the Match Summary for any player bands in any ongoing Royale. When on the bracket screen just click the new "Match Summary" icon to view a completed match summary.

[h3]Rockers' Licenses[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/4803443ee1e64df1800f76ccc551b937625c6ee1.png[/img]

Finally, as you may have noticed from the Match Summary screenshots, we've added customizable Rockers' Licenses! Choose your title, background and sticker to add a little flair to your proof of residence in Riff City. You can change up your license on the Player page of the Compendium.

Credits as a reward for a Tour Victory!
We wanted to add another way for players to earn credits, and decided to award them in Tour Mode. Right now, if you win a Tour run you'll earn 150 credits to spend on outfits in Joe's Variety Shop.

"Freeto's Four Piece" Changes:
"Freeto's Four Piece" has been updated so they do not rely on energy generation but instead "Snackrificial Sharing" buffs Freeto's cards, on top of that the energy levels and costs of some cards have been changed to fit the new crew and buff based Freeto's Four Piece"

Bug Fixes, Balance changes and Quality of Life:
Royale Bot gear updated removing all activatable gears and replacing with bot useable gear.
"Gear Getter" upgrade "Aggressive" replaced with "Protective"
Vendors have been updated to have more variety.
Tutorial text updates to help clarify a few things.
That's all for today's broadcast! Go get on your thinking caps, check out these illuminating new features, and be sure to drop by our discord if you have any notes!

notes.title: Full 1.0 Release November 13th!
notes.content:
[i]It's time for Battle Bands to take center stage, and we want YOU in the limelight with us![/i]

[h2]Battle Bands is leaving Early Access and going 1.0 on the 13th of November!![/h2]

[h3]The Moon Rises[/h3]
The Metal Moon Rising event will start simultaneously with the launch of Battle Bands 1.0. This ongoing event includes an all new, totally free, Metal themed Backstage Pass. We've also added 30+ new cosmetics to Joe's Variety Shop, and of course, new Metal skins for all the NPCs you'll be challenging in Riff City.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/20d2e2d15b832466a237546be5b2fab42a7b4e31.png[/img]

[h3]A Shadow Falls[/h3]
The Shadow Reign creeps into Riff City on release. This new Reign mixes the other Reigns together for all sorts of possible Card, Moment, and Gear combinations. Battle the Shadow-version of your band as the Final Boss.
The Shadow Reign uses your previous winning run to create a Shadow-version of your band, complete with your Cards, Gear, and style. Can you best yourself?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/f00fce06602b3afce1d4d8cfd24624558bb73fd1.png[/img]

[h3]Grand Royale Expands[/h3]
Grand Royale will now have it's own Super Vendors, as well as unique Opening Moments at the start of the Royale. There are also 9 new Iconic Bots scattered amongst competitors in both the Grand Royale and the normal Royale. Defeating an Iconic Bot rewards players with a unique cosmetic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/0a027f04e58d35fd973badf9dfe1128d2fad3357.png[/img]

Now that we're headed to the big show, we could use your help more than ever to get the word out about Battle Bands! If you like our game, tell your friends about us! Thanks to everyone who has helped us make Battle Bands the best it can be and we can't wait to share more with you all!

This will allow them to play single-player Tour Mode, earn Backstage Pass rewards, claim Milestones and spend credits at Joe's Variety (formerly known as the Shop). Royale Mode and the High Score system will only be available when connecting while online. Offline Mode will help more players play Battle Bands more easily and that (we think) is awesome.

notes.title: Battle Bands Early Access Patch #27: The Single Player Experience Update!!
notes.content:
[i]Like a puppet on a six string, you're listening to Riff Radio and we've got some big news for you![/i]

The Single Player Experience Update brings players a whole new level of control, allowing bot bandmates to be set to play Automatically OR MANUALLY- meaning YOU play for them! In Tour Mode, turn timers can be switched off and the Load In/Load Out timers are disabled entirely. Also, we're  introducing the ability to select which Reigns your Tour will fall under from the Band Setup screen, along with the other settings mentioned above.

[h2]New Band Setup Options[/h2]

[h3]Manual Bot Control!!![/h3]
Long awaited and much requested, players can now control all the members of the band! Simply access the hands of any bot bandmates you control by selecting them or using the number keys, then play their hand as you would your own!

[h3]No Time for Timers[/h3]
Additionally, to go along with Manual Bot Control and because we thought it was fun, the option to deactivate turn timers has been added to Tour Mode. Disabling turn timers not only allows Manual Control mode to shine, it also allows for a much more calculating and deliberate Tour experience!

[h3]Bot Speed[/h3]
Bots in Tour Mode can now be set to one of four speeds- Slow, Normal, Fast and Hyper. This will effect bot bandmates as well as opponents so you can either get a better look at what everyone is playing or shave a few minutes off your run and squeeze one more in!

[h3]Reign Select[/h3]
Players can now choose which Reigns they may encounter when starting a new Tour. This allows anyone hoping to challenge (or avoid) a specific Final Boss to do so more easily, but there's a catch! All Reigns are active by default, and you have to beat a Reign first before you can choose to disable it.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/1aaaa2383b0900132d998537608b18210c99dbe6.png[/img]
You can find these new settings on the Band Setup Screen, so get in there and start playing around with them- we can't wait to see what kinds of wild strategies you drum up!

[h3]Quality of Life Changes:[/h3]
[b]Updated Bot[/b] weight to more efficiently deal with low priority cards and make sure not to waste as much energy. 
[b]Tell bots what to play[/b] using the middle click ping on cards in their hands, in case you disagree with their priorities. This works with manual or automatic bots.
[b]All Load In/Load Out timers[/b] have been removed from Tour Mode.

[h3]Balance Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Strong Bassline" now gives +3 protection on complete.
[*] "Smash The Keys" no longer self discards hand, takes 1 fewer protection from opponent.
[*] "Keyboardists Cacophony" no longer takes protection from own band.
[*] "Intense Keys" now modifies cards on play instead of on complete.
[*] "Audacious Lick" upgrade "Heavy" replaced with "Patiently"
[*] "Sad Melody" upgrade "Rejuvenating" replaced with "Safe"
[*] "Building Backbeat" upgrade "Quickly" replaced with "Practiced"
[*] "Riff Of Gratitude" no longer has "Daring" upgrade.
[*] Over character pop out widgets now match pop up effect icons.
[/list]
[i]And that's all the news we've got for you big bosses today! We're always looking for feedback, but we need it even more than usual with this huuuuge update! Join our discord to share your thoughts and to find bandmates to try the new features out with! Thanks for listening![/i]

notes.title: Early Access Patch #25: Sirens Reign and Tons More!
notes.content:
[i]What's up, everybody, you're listening to Riff Radio! There's a new Reigning Boss Band in town, and that's only what's bubbling beneath the surface of one DEEP update![/i]

[b]Early Access Patch #25 Brings so much to Battle Bands, including but not limited to: [/b]
[list]
[*] A new Reign headed by "Sirens Scream"
[*] "The Final Judgement" chilling out and battling as a normal boss under the moniker "The Judgement" 
[*] All the normal Bosses have been shifted and updated for balance and clarity.
[*] The bots, both friend and foe, have been overhauled to be smarter, more responsive and better team players.
[*] Protection is now removed at the end of your opponents turn. This applies to both Player bands, and Boss bands.
[*] In Match UI has been improved to more clearly communicate what cards are effecting whom and how.
[*] And so many other general fixes and changes that it's hard to express just how big this update really is!
[/list]
[h1]Sirens Scream Reign:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/dd522266289f95bf88e43afc6e6fac8b8bde4715.png[/img]

"A rising tide raises all boats" - or so the saying goes. When Sirens Scream is raising the tide, boats have a funny way of going in the other direction. As the waves rise in Riff City, so do the hopes of many potential Crew-mates. Use their ambition to your advantage or against your opponents with some fishy new strategies that really hold water! 

[list]
[b]5 New Player Cards[/b] that enable crew to be copied, stolen, buffed and used against other bands.

[b]12 New Gear[/b] to help navigate the crowded, watery streets of Riff City.

[b]4 New Moments[/b] to discover as Riff City slowly sinks beneath the waves.

[b]2 New Card Upgrades[/b] that let existing strategies morph and shift like a rushing river.

[/list]
Overcome the allure of the "[b]Sirens Scream[/b]" as you hold your friends close and [i]fish-friends[/i] closer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/de949b1d2ecaec09d3f6e1c05d57eb06e81bb136.png[/img]

[h2]The Judgement[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/b9064c24810e3bcf336941e9c20008b6679bcfe4.png[/img]

When not reigning over Riff City with a velvet fist, this tall and mysterious figure can be found working on themselves at the Night Beach. Spending their time tempting all who cross this sandy path...

"The Judgment" is now a Boss that can be found in Riff City... when they aren't busy reigning as "The Final Judgement".

[h2]Tour Mode Bosses Overhaul[/h2]
Bosses have had their general strategies updated to be more understandable. This has led to some Bosses having cards removed and many of their cards being adjusted to read more clearly and work alongside the [i]new Protection change[/i].

notes.title: Early Access Patch #23: The Reign System Update!
notes.content:
The power dynamics are shifting in Riff City!

Both [b]The Bardbarians[/b] and [b]The Scrap Titan[/b] have decided to step up and take the mantle as... Reigning Champion of Riff City! While under their individual rule, things in Riff City will change.

[u][h1]Reign System:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/d7ed1aded7a271dbcd806af274676838766c67dd.png[/img]

There are now [b]three possible Final Bosses[/b] to encounter in Tour Mode. Each Final Boss changes your Tour to have different Reign specific Player Cards, Upgrades, Moments (Opening & Map), and Gear effected by who you will face in Final Arena. 

Every Tour and Royale will have a Reign randomly chosen at its start. The Reign can be identified by the Opening Moment and on the Tour map by the icon above the Final Arena (in the middle of Riff City).


[i]
[u][b][h1]Spoilers Ahead![/h1][/b][/u] [/i]


[u][h1]New Bosses:[/h1][/u]
[h3][u][b]The Final Scrapper:[/b][/u][/h3]
The Scrap Titan has put in the work and has upgraded to his final form! Now harder hitting! His alliance with the Gear Getters of Riff City has given him the strength to take over the city as he tries to convert it into Scrap!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/c9cbfdb7f8063792bd104b541869bb8dc303fbc4.png[/img]

[h3][u][b]Bardbarians Unleashed:[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/fd680a2df326aaf2a8308ea0f1dd1bdc858b8f74.png[/img]

[h3][u][b]The Final Judgement:[/b][/u][/h3]
The Final Judgement remains in the Final Arena as one of three possible Final Bosses - but the city around him has changed. Discover new cards, gear, and moments that aim to spice up this familiar foe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/ca5fbc985d41a006c12961ac05f806464042f8fd.png[/img]

[u][h1]New Cards:[/h1][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/41c98215f007f438a3cae46ca996aad7e3f62993.png[/img]

Each Reign includes [i]Five[/i] New Player Cards (One for each Instrument and one Common between them all). These enable specific strategies and are designed to reflect the Reign. The new cards are only available in their specific Reign, so there is no overlap.
All the available cards can be viewed in the Compendium and will be denoted with their specific Reign Icon. This lets players know which cards are available in which Reign.

[u][h1]New Reign Upgrades:[/h1][/u]
Every Reign will introduce [b]two unique upgrades[/b] across many new and current cards. These upgrades can be viewed in the Compendium and will be [i]marked[/i] with their Reign Icon; these upgrades will only be available in the specific Reign they are a part of.

*"[b]Under Cover[/b]" +1 protection on play for every 1 gear your band has.
*"[b]Empowering[/b]" All Cards in players had gain +1 hype for the rest of the match.
*"[b]Enhanced[/b]" +1 hype on play for every 2 gear your band has.
*"[b]Quieting[/b]" All Cards in random opponents hand get -1 hype for the rest of the match.
*"[b]Daring[/b]" +2 "Good Idea" to random opponents hand.
*"[b]Shining[/b]" Exhaust 1 card in random opponents hand.

[h2][u]Core Card Upgrades[/u][/h2]

*"[b]Power[/b]" Ends other bands Song Section.

[u][h1]New Moments:[/h1][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/1c9fd8f4a39be8b7dc5a6d16402cfa29b256afe9.png[/img]

On top of 6 new "Core" Moments that have a chance to appear in every Tour  --  each Reign adds a few moments that are specific to the new Ruler of Riff City. Each Reign also has a few unique Opening Moments for both Tour and Royale Mode. The Opening Moments will give players some new and varied starting options, while also informing them of the Reign they are entering.

[u][h1]New Gear:[/h1][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/20ee2d2474bfad7f8fce424ab4b6fb3cb62b5aea.png[/img]

Each Reign adds unique Gear that can be found in Vendors and Moments throughout Riff City. This new Gear can also be found in Royale as a way to reinforce existing strategies and expand upon new ones.

[u][h1]Royale Reigns:[/h1][/u]
As you may have guessed - the Reign System does not stop in Tour Mode. Every Royale will also be designated a random Reign, which includes Opening Moments, Player Cards, Upgrades and a Reign Specific Vendor.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/c5f9343035beea2f39d4ccd8188c0ed71584e3ec.png[/img]

[u][h1]Riff City News:[/h1][/u]
Along with the Reign System, we've added a News widget to the Main Menu. This displays some of the recent game updates, events and will usually include a link to the Steam Patch Notes for more information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/a9659b265cc5b31217f808c98b90490d420973df.png[/img]

[*] Tour Vendor UI layout updated.

We are super excited to hear how everyone fares against these new Final Bosses, and we hope to battle against you in this Fridays 3pm (EST) Grand Royale!

notes.title: Feats and Milestones Preview
notes.content:
[i]Get the lead out, it's time to listen to [b]Riff Radio![/b][/i]

How we doing, fellow Riff-ians? Thanks for tuning in to this Riff Radio News Update! We've got a couple of upcoming challenge systems to share with you today: [b]Feats and Milestones[/b]

[h2]Feats[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/1225615572df9f44b4d036459323e8d4d515bcfc.png[/img]

Feats are special challenges you can complete to earn extra credits, Backstage Pass XP, and even cosmetics. You have 3 active Feats at a time, pulled randomly from a large pool, and can refresh one of them every 24 hours. Completing and claiming the reward for a Feat will also refresh it. Feats will provide some extra challenge for players and get them to try new strategies in Tour and Royale!

[h2]Milestones[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/4b459c99040a3c9ecb5deca0bca89d6f62a92538.png[/img]

Milestones are similar to Feats, but work a little differently. Milestones will keep track of things players will mostly do passively, like playing certain types of cards or sharing energy, and reward them for it! Once you complete a Milestone, you'll be able to claim it for rewards and Prestige! After that, the Milestone will roll over to the same objective with a higher goal.

[h2]Prestige[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/de1376b982b63e48b833a8a9b54f4f8f68fc4c7f.png[/img]

Prestige is a new system in which players will receive a rank based on how many Milestones they've completed, providing irrefutable proof that you're a seasoned musician tearing up the mean streets of Riff City!


[i]And that wraps up today's Riff Radio news update! What do you think about the Feats and Milestones systems? Getting any crazy ideas for Feats you wanna share yet? Pull on up to the Battle Bands Discord to give your thoughts and as always- thanks for listening![/i]

notes.title: Roadmap, Tour Score and Difficulty Modifiers Preview
notes.content:
HELLL-OO! Welcome BACK to Riff Radio, Riff City's number one source for all the updates you need to get your band to the TOP of the charts!

[h1][b]The Roadmap[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/a3c35471cfc9f65e2fa05c90719ebbd3b9a1a1f7.png[/img]

ALRIGHT, we've been getting lots of call-ins from you guys about this one- It's the Battle Bands Feature Roadmap! Now keep in mind that this is a living, [i]BREATHING[/i], [b]ROCKING[/b] Roadmap, which means it's going to change as we add to it and possibly swap things around! Also, we'll be broadcasting plenty more specifics on EVERYTHING on this list in the coming months, so DON'T TOUCH THAT DIAL! (I'm serious)
[i]
We're working on multiple things at any given time, so the actual order of released features will not always line up with the order they are listed on the Roadmap![/i]

[h1]Tour Score[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/d5caf7148827c6be69dee45a60dc992842c5815f.png[/img]

NEXT up we've got a brand new way to show your friends you're better than them, the Tour Score! Once the feature is in place, you'll receive a Tour Score at the end of each of your Tour runs which you can then compare against your own previous high score AND the high scores of every other band playing in town!

"BUT WHAT DETERMINES THIS FANCY NEW SCORE?", I hear you shouting into your van's radio. Well pipe down and we'll tell ya!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/64283032f246f028afb397edc07105dac62945d5.png[/img]

Your score is determined by a number of factors, like the amount of Matches you won, how much cash you saved, your band's morale and your final Tour Level. To really crank your score up, though, you'll need to tweak some Tour Amplifiers!

[h1]Tour Amplifiers[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738613/e89d45115cbb6fbb70a1ba39fe69a405fc5f7b2e.png[/img]

Tour Amplifiers are Tour Mode exclusive difficulty modifiers that can make your run easier or harder, lowering or raising a multiplier on your Tour Score. The four Amplifiers we'll be starting out with are:

[list]
[*][b]Boss Strength[/b] - Determines the starting Tour Level for rival boss bands
[*][b]Upgrade Pips[/b] - Determines how many times a card needs to be played to be upgraded
[*][b]Boss Hype[/b] - Determines how much hype rival boss bands start with in each match
[*][b]Inflation[/b] - Raises or lowers prices across Riff City
[/list]

Down the line, we're planning on adding even more Tour Amplifiers for you guys to mess around with.

[h3]And that wraps up today's Riff Radio news update! Before I let you get back to head-banging, be sure to join our Discord if you're looking for new band-mates to play with or want to give us some feedback. We love hearing from you punks, so don't be shy and as always- thanks for listening![/h3]

Ranks are designated as below, increasing every 200 Rank points:
Novice (1-5): 0-1000
Amateur (1-5): 1000-2000  
Opener (1-5): 2000-3000
Headliner (1-10): 3000-5000
Legend: 5000+

Round 1: 0 Rank Points
Round 2: 0 Rank Points
Round 3: +5 Rank Points
Round 4: +10 Rank Points
Round 5: +30 Rank Points
Finale: +75 Rank Points

The Higher rank you become the more rank points you lose when you are defeated in a Royale match, raising the stakes and making progress more challenging:
Novice: -0 Rank Points
Amateur: -5 Rank Points
Opener: -10 Rank Points
Headliner: -25 Rank Points

The farther you are the more important victory is to gaining Rank!

We need feedback so we can make Battle Bands the best game it can be, and you we're counting on you, the players, to get it!
Our [url=http://discord.gg/W8SpQBpggA]discord[/url] is a great place to share your thoughts and ideas and meet great band mates and rivals! 
We also have surveys for [url=https://forms.gle/iUfLaf1LqM9dYrzV7]feedback[/url] and [url=https://forms.gle/NSfCfNeWv2QvkWtM6]bugs[/url] that help us improve Battle Bands faster and more directly.
[url=discord.gg/battlebands][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1322100/extras/BB_steamBody_discordHeader.png?t=1647433923[/img][/url]

[h2]The Future[/h2]
We have tons planned for Battle Bands moving forward, this is only the beginning of Riff City and its wild musical antics!

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
Nothing is sacred, you are the measure we use to find out what is working and what needs to change. Through early access we will often be pushing balance changes, optimization, fixes for bugs, and shifts in the meta in order to keep Battle Bands fresh and fair. The largest changes will occur with the release of new seasons every few months.

[h3]Seasons:[/h3]
Every Season will introduce a new full season pass of cosmetics to unlock, as well as themed content that may include new tour mode Bosses and moments to make sure Riff city evolves. Seasons will also be where we unveil additional features and larger changes.

[h3]Additions:[/h3]
As development continues through early access we will be adding in new moments and bosses in tour mode as well as new gear, arenas, challenges, and of course cards to help Riff City grow and Battle bands evolve. 

We will be using your responses to Battle Bands to get an idea of where changes and additions could most benefit the game and we hope you have fun rocking out!
